item.title: [翻译] Lenny's Newsletter: 薪资谈判实战手册：如何体面争取20-40%涨薪
item.description:
标签: #薪资谈判 #求职技巧 #谈判策略

摘要: 本文介绍了高管谈判专家Jacob Warwick的实战策略：将求职视为企业销售流程，通过提前收集信息、把握时机并以协作姿态沟通，可在不显得贪婪的情况下有效争取20%-40%的薪酬提升。

原标题: The tactical playbook for getting 20-40% more comp (without sounding greedy) | Jacob Warwick (Executive Negotiator)

Jacob Warwick is an executive negotiation coach who helps senior operators negotiate better salary, equity, titles, and severance packages. He has worked with leaders across tech and Hollywood, was previously a founder and CEO himself, and has helped clients secure millions in additional compensation. His approach focuses on collaboration over confrontation, understanding motivations, and treating job searches like enterprise sales processes.

Jacob Warwick 是一位高管谈判教练，专注于帮助资深职场人士协商更优的薪资（salary）、股权（equity）、职位头衔和遣散费方案。他曾与科技和好莱坞领域的领导者合作，本人也曾是创始人和 CEO，已帮助客户争取到数百万美元的额外薪酬。他的方法强调协作而非对抗，注重理解对方动机，并将求职过程视为企业级销售流程。

Listen on YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts

收听平台：YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple Podcasts

We discuss:

  • Why a simple "What's the chance there's a little more here?" often unlocks a 20% bump
  • Why Jacob sees 40% average movement when negotiations are run well
  • When negotiation actually starts (hint: it's much earlier than you think)
  • Why information + timing create power
  • The biggest mistakes people make when negotiating
  • How to navigate the important "What's your comp expectation?" question without anchoring too low
  • Why the best interviews feel more like discovery calls than interrogations
  • 为什么简单的一句"这里是否还有可能再增加一些？"通常能带来 20% 的涨幅
  • 为什么 Jacob 观察到，当谈判运作得当，平均能实现 40% 的薪酬变动
  • 谈判实际上从何时开始（提示：比你想象的早得多）
  • 为什么信息 + 时机 = 力量
  • 人们在谈判中犯的最大错误
  • 如何应对关键的"你的薪酬期望是多少？"这一问题，避免锚定效应（anchoring）过低
  • 为什么最优秀的面试感觉更像需求挖掘电话（discovery calls），而非审讯
